text_blocks.snippet: It is important to note that while mental illness does not discriminate, societal stigma and discrimination against people with mental health conditions can exist. This can lead to unequal access to treatment and support, which can worsen mental health outcomes.

We must work to create a society where everyone with mental health conditions feels supported and has equal access to care. This includes challenging stereotypes, reducing stigma, and ensuring that people with mental illness have the same rights and protections as others.
